a simple asymmetric Henry reaction is a powerful tool for the construction of tetrahydropyrans with high diastereoselectivity and enantioselectivity, and can be combined with other useful one-pot processes to provide a highly efficient and practical asymmetric synthesis of complex tetrahydropyanols.
